title: Stomp
description:
Deal 12 damage to ALL enemies.
Costs 1 less energy for each Attack played this turn.
upgraded_description:
Deal 15 damage to ALL enemies.
Costs 1 less energy for each Attack played this turn.
notes: Cost reduction is applied retroactively when the card enters combat (reduced by the count of attacks already played) and dynamically reduced by 1 each time any Attack is played by the owner.
